# MISSION — Self-Evolving Agents Hackathon (tokens&, DG717, Fri Jul 24 2026)

**This file is ground truth. Do not edit it without saying so in `.cowork/LOG.md`.**

## The challenge (verbatim from stage)
> **Build agents that evolve.**
> Ship an autonomous agent that self evolves in a continuous /loop to achieve a /goal.
> Your agent(s) need to take **real action**. Publish, monitor, orchestrate, transact; grounded in real sources.
> **Publish your agent's output to cited.md.** Monetize it with agent payment rails (x402, MPP, CDP, agentic.market).

Organizer emphasis: *"demonstrate retention and improvement as the agent evolves in loops."*

## Judging criteria (5)
| Criterion | What they actually ask |
|---|---|
| **Autonomy** | Does your agent self-improve using **real-time data** with **no manual intervention**? |
| **Idea** | Potential to solve a meaningful problem / real-world value. "Projects that can get funded." |
| **Technical Implementation** | How well was it built? Judges are technical — they want to be *surprised*. |
| **Tool Use** | Did you effectively use **at least 3 sponsor tools**? (2 is OK, 3+ scores better) |
| **Presentation** | **3-minute live demo. No slides.** Most impactful demo wins the room. |

## Hard deadlines (America/Los_Angeles)
- **16:30** — project submission closes. Warnings at 15:30 and 16:00.
- 16:30–18:00 — judging in back rooms + networking
- **19:00** — award ceremony
- Max 4 people per team. You must **explicitly select each sponsor prize** you want considered for.

## Sponsors, what they own, and their prizes
| Sponsor | Role in the loop | Prize |
|---|---|---|
| **Google DeepMind** (Gemini) | Reason, plan, use tools | — |
| **Guild.ai** — guild.ai | Control plane: govern, run, trace agents. Has a one-button "optimize this workspace" that rewrites LLM steps into deterministic ones. Open beta, 50M free tokens. | $1000 / two × $500 (Visa) |
| **Replay QA** — CEO Brian Hackett | Drop-in QA for web apps. Feed it a URL → detailed, root-caused bug reports your agent can consume. REST **and** MCP APIs. | $1500 / $1000 / $500 |
| **Actian VectorAI DB** | Portable, off-cloud vector DB = **persistent agent memory**. "Failure mode is state, not intelligence." Warning from their rep: must be a *thoughtful* part of the app, not bolted on. | $500 / $300 / $200 |
| **Pioneer (Fastino Labs)** — pioneer.ai, agent.pioneer.ai | Inference API + **model router** that gets cheaper/better with your traffic. Simplest use: point your coding agent at it. | Track prize, flexible |
| **Band AI** — band.ai, docs.band.ai/jam | Agent-to-agent mesh. Agents talk in chat rooms via @mentions, humans in the loop. **Jam** onboards multiple Claude Code sessions as collaborating peers. | $1000 best project using Band |
| **Senso Context OS** — docs.senso.ai | Programmable knowledge base for agents; endpoints to **publish content to the web so agents can discover it** — a self-improving content loop. Has a CLI you hand to your agent. $100 credit on signup. | $2000 / $1000 / $500 |

Actian's own suggested stack slide: **DeepMind (reason) → Guild (govern) → Replay (verify) → Actian (persist) → Pioneer (improve inference)**, with the tagline *"Slow loop: improve the model. Fast loop: retrieve experience for the next decision."*

## The bar to clear
A judge must **watch a number improve, live, across loop iterations** — cost per run, steps per task, bugs remaining, accuracy. Retention must be visible: iteration N is better *because* iteration N-1 wrote something down.
